newsitem.title: GERMANY: T&N Kolbenschmidt stake option lapsed - paper.
newsitem.headline: T&N Kolbenschmidt stake option lapsed - paper.

text.p: British car components manufacturer T & N Plc has let its option to buy a 24.99 percent stake in Germany's Kolbenschmidt AG run out, making a takeover of Kolbenschmidt increasingly unlikely, Boersen-Zeitung reported on Friday.
T & N had an option to buy Commerzbank AG's former 49.99 percent holding in Kolbenschmidt but was prevented from doing so by German cartel authorities.

Commerzbank in December transferred 24.99 percent of its Kolbenschmidt stake to Metallbank GmbH, which was acting on behalf of a group of European investors, and T & N said it had extended its option to buy that portion until September 1997.
T & N had been expected to retain the option to buy the remainder of the 49.99 percent stake by arranging for a British bank to take it over from Commerzbank, Boersen-Zeitung reported.
Now Commerzbank is free to dispose of the 24.99 percent stake as it pleases, the paper said.
